asked_fact_assessments.explanation: The quoted whole-entry text supplies this asked fact accurately.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: One or more involved ill districts triggers the ordinary illness action effect once for the action, not once per ill district.

support_locations.quote: Globalsec gains 1 capital per enemy unit removed from a district; Haas-Bioroid gains 2 when one or more androids move; Jinteki gains 2 per illness token removed from a district; Melange gains 3 after an event if threat did not rise by 2 or more during the whole event; NBN gains 1 per stage unrest decreases; Weyland gains 2 per outage removed from a district.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Haas gains two for one or more android moves, at most once per turn.

asked_fact_assessments.explanation: The quoted whole-entry text supplies this asked fact accurately.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Non-Melange contracts require action resolution regardless of its resolver.

support_locations.quote: Contract capital always goes to the corporation that owns that contract, regardless of which player resolves the triggering action. Except for Melange, a contract triggers only through resolving an action card; any player may resolve that action.

asked_fact_assessments.explanation: The quoted whole-entry text supplies this asked fact accurately.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Movement/Root are not qualifying district removals; outage clearing unrest pays no NBN.

Removing unrest because an outage is placed does not trigger this contract.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Melange gains three after event only if its entire threat increase is less than two, including Root spillover.

support_locations.quote: After resolving an event, gain 3 capital if threat did not increase by at least 2 over that entire event. Include threat from component placements and movement to the Root, not just the event's upper effect.
